sources.name: Kenney Interface Sounds
sources.contributes: Bundled sounds click (click_002), tick (tick_002), pop (drop_002), pluck (pluck_001) and glitch (glitch_001). Resampled to 48 kHz mono, silence trimmed, peak normalized to -3 dBFS, 16-bit FLAC.

sources.name: Kenney Impact Sounds
sources.contributes: Bundled sounds impact (impactPunch_heavy_000) and thud (impactSoft_heavy_001). Resampled to 48 kHz mono, silence trimmed, peak normalized to -3 dBFS, 16-bit FLAC.

sources.name: Swishes Sound Pack by artisticdude
sources.contributes: Bundled sounds swish (swish-3) and swoosh (swish-7). Resampled to 48 kHz mono, silence trimmed, peak normalized to -3 dBFS, 16-bit FLAC.

sources.name: Air whoosh by pyranostudios
sources.contributes: Bundled sound whoosh: 0.15 s to 1.45 s, faded in over 0.25 s and out over 0.7 s. Resampled to 48 kHz mono, silence trimmed, peak normalized to -3 dBFS, 16-bit FLAC.

sources.name: Power-Up Sound Effects by spring-spring
sources.contributes: Bundled sound riser: the first 1.29 s of power_up_sound_v1. Resampled to 48 kHz mono, silence trimmed, peak normalized to -3 dBFS, 16-bit FLAC.

sources.name: Calm Loop by wipics
sources.contributes: Bundled music bed bed-calm, the whole loop. Resampled to 48 kHz mono, normalized to -19 LUFS, 16-bit FLAC.

sources.name: Loading screen loop by haeldb
sources.contributes: Bundled music bed bed-pulse, the whole loop. Resampled to 48 kHz mono, normalized to -19 LUFS, 16-bit FLAC.

sources.name: Chill lofi inspired (loop edit) by qubodup
sources.contributes: Bundled music bed bed-lofi: bars 17 to 24 at 106.18 BPM (sample 1736496 for 867960 samples at 48 kHz), the next 0.1 s folded into the head on an equal-power fade so it loops. Resampled to 48 kHz mono, normalized to -19 LUFS, 16-bit FLAC.
